within_loop.tip_detection: train-only observed x global minimum and global maximum index
within_loop.area_metric: closed signed polygon, completed curve replaces heldout x and force with fitted predictions, train observations retained
within_loop.percentage_denominator: absolute signed area of observed full loop, evaluation only
within_loop.report: mean per condition first, aggregate across nine conditions, bootstrap at condition level, B=50000, seed=20261009

time_ordered.training: one early cycle per condition, all 571 points; no later fit/recalibration
time_ordered.baseline: unfitted phase-aligned early measurement used at all future target cycles
time_ordered.predictor: known/common index i/570; no prediction of future phase alignment
time_ordered.status: exploratory repeated timepoints within three experimental conditions, not 15 independent experimental subjects

blocked_gap: reanalysis of all 27 published R7 within-loop 171-contiguous-point tests, no winner-only selection
requires_feature_availability: predefined matched sample index and complete length of 571 points
